description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Sri Lanka National Policy on Alcohol Control - 2015
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the establishment of a new national policy framework for alcohol control. It outlines legal principles, strategic objectives, and regulatory measures to govern alcohol consumption, which falls under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. While it mentions government bodies like the Cabinet of Ministers and Ministry of Health, the core content is about policy and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
